name.en: RG Evangelion exclusive restraint and mobile injection table set

ja: 使徒襲来！
ＥＶＡ、全機発進！―
「ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版」より、「RG EVANGELION」シリーズと組み合わせて楽しむ「輸送台」が単品商品として商品化。
新規水転写式デカールやA.T.フィールドを再現するエフェクトパーツも付属。
●　ＥＶＡ発進シーンを再現！
ネルフ本部にてＥＶＡを地上へ射出する専用の輸送台兼拘束具がＲＧシリーズにラインアップ。
臨場感を演出する細やかなディテールを再現。組み立てるだけで劇中設定が再現可能。
地上射出後の、両肩両腕の安全装置を解除するスライドギミックを搭載。
●　新規デザイン水転写式デカールが付属
●　A.T.フィールドエフェクトパーツが付属

en: Apostle attack!
EVA, all aircraft take off! ―
From "Rebuild of Evangelion ", the " transport platform " that can be enjoyed in combination with the " RG EVANGELION" series has been commercialized as a single item.
New water slide decals and effect parts that reproduce the A.T. field are also included.
● Reproduce the EVA launch scene!
At NERV Headquarters, the RG series is a special transport platform and restraint device for ejecting EVA to the ground.
Reproduces detailed details that create a sense of realism. Settings from the play can be reproduced just by Assembly.
Equipped with a slide gimmick that releases the safety devices on both shoulders and arms after ground launch.
● Newly designed water transfer decal included
● A.T. field effect parts included
<Recommended combination kit> *Sold separately.
